description: Per-workload Kubernetes drill-down: pick a namespace and an app, see how it is actually running. Complements 'Catalyst K8s - Full System Ops' (cluster/node capacity) by answering the app-level question instead: is it throttled, is it near its memory limit, why did it restart. Every metric was grounded against Mimir at authoring time.

panels.title: Overview — is this workload healthy right now?
Pods Running
panels.description: Pods of the selected workload(s) in phase=Running.

targets.expr: count(group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}) and on(namespace,pod) group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace",phase="Running"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods NOT Running
panels.description: Pending/Failed/Unknown. Non-zero here is the first thing to chase.

targets.expr: count(group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}) and on(namespace,pod) group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace",phase!="Running",phase!="Succeeded"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers Not Ready
panels.description: Pod exists but fails its readiness probe, so it receives NO Service traffic. This is what '0/1 Ready' looks like — the pod is up but effectively out of rotation.

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"$namespace",condition="true"} == 0 and on(namespace,pod) group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Restarts (1h)
panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour across the selection.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Peak CPU Throttling
panels.description: Share of CFS periods where the container hit its CPU limit and was hard-stalled for the rest of that 100ms window. ONLY containers WITH a cpu limit emit this, so a workload with no limit correctly reads 0. Sustained >25% means the limit is the bottleneck, not the code.

targets.expr: max(100 * sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) / sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Peak Memory vs Limit
panels.description: Working set as a share of the memory LIMIT. Memory is incompressible: crossing 100% is an OOMKill, not a slowdown. Reads 0 when no memory limit is set.

targets.expr: max(100 * sum by (namespace,pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) / sum by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM Kills (24h)
panels.description: Real OOM kill events from cAdvisor. Distinguishes a genuine memory kill from a liveness-probe restart — the two are indistinguishable in restart counts alone.

targets.expr: sum(increase(container_oom_events_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods Ready
panels.description: Pods passing readiness — i.e. actually serving traffic.

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"$namespace",condition="true"} == 1 and on(namespace,pod) group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU usage per pod (cores)
panels.description: CPU burn per pod, with the aggregate request/limit for context. Usage riding the limit line while throttling climbs means the limit is the constraint.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace",resource="cpu"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",resource="cpu"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

panels.title: CPU throttling % per pod
panels.description: THE panel for 'it is slow but the CPU graph looks fine'. A throttled container is stalled outright for the rest of each 100ms period, so latency and probe timeouts spike while AVERAGE cpu stays low. No series = no CPU limit set, nothing to throttle against.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

panels.title: Memory working set per pod
panels.description: Working set is what the kernel counts against the limit (RSS + active page cache). This is the number that triggers an OOMKill — not RSS.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

panels.title: Memory % of limit per pod
panels.description: Headroom before an OOMKill. NO SERIES here means no memory limit is set — unbounded, so the pod can pressure the NODE into evictions instead of being killed itself.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

panels.title: Restarts over time
panels.description: Restart events over time. Correlate spikes against the throttling and memory panels above to tell a probe-kill apart from an OOMKill.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

panels.title: Last termination reason
panels.description: Why each container died last time: OOMKilled vs Error vs Completed. 'Completed' (exit 0) on a long-running service usually means it was SIGTERMed by a failing liveness probe — NOT a memory problem.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) > 0

panels.title: Containers waiting (CrashLoopBackOff etc.)
panels.description: Containers stuck in a waiting state and why — CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"})) > 0

sum by (pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

sum by (pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left() group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

panels.title: Pods in selection
panels.description: Every pod the current namespace/workload filter resolves to, and the node it runs on. Use this to confirm the filter selects what you expect.

targets.expr: group by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace"} and on(namespace,pod) group by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload-[^-]+"} or kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind!="ReplicaSet",owner_name=~"$workload"}))

title: Workload Ops - Namespace & App Drill-down
